name: Marco
source: A higher-up of the mafia. He has a polite personality, seemingly unfitting for that of a powerful mafia member. Marco has a smile that hides a million secrets, but he is always gentlemanly and careful not to let any unnecessary information slip. The other mafia members put all their trust in Marco, but they might have reason to doubt…
